# Story 18 — Team Collaboration

## Prerequisites

- Story 01 — Authentication & Login completed (JWT auth + `ClaimsPrincipalExtensions` provide the acting user id).
- Story 03 — Roles & Permissions completed (permission constants in `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Domain/Roles/Permissions.cs`, `HasPermissionAttribute` in `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Api/Authorization/`).
- Story 11 — Ticket Creation & Tracking completed (Ticket entity + `TicketsService` exist).
- Story 12 — Ticket Assignment completed (assignee semantics established; this story must **not** change assignee).
- Story 13 — Ticket Status & Escalation completed (status semantics established; this story must **not** change status).
- Story 15 — Agent Dashboard completed (Agent Desk shell in place).
- Coordinate with any owner of `TicketDetailPage.tsx` — the ticket detail page will gain a new **Internal Collaboration** tab/section alongside existing **Ticket History**.

---

## Story Goal

Add an internal, staff-only collaboration thread to each Ticket so authorized Agents and Managers can discuss the ticket without touching customer-facing communication, ticket status, or ticket assignee.

Concrete outcomes:

1. New endpoints under `/api/tickets/{ticketId}/collaboration-comments` to list and create internal comments.
2. New EF Core entity `TicketCollaborationComment` persisted in its own table (kept separate from any future customer-visible reply table and separate from `TicketHistory`).
3. New permissions `tickets.collaboration.view` and `tickets.collaboration.create`, seeded and enforced.
4. Every create writes an audit log entry (`ticket.collaboration.comment.created`) via the existing `IAuditLogService`.
5. Frontend adds an **Internal Collaboration** panel on `TicketDetailPage.tsx` with visual "Internal — not visible to customer" styling, an empty state, author + timestamp per comment, and a compose/reply form.
6. Adding a comment **does not** modify `Ticket.Status`, `Ticket.AssignedUserId`, or any customer-facing field.

**Out of scope (do not implement here):** customer-facing replies, email/SMS/chat channels, notifications, quick replies, tasks/reminders, SLA, auto assignment, auto escalation, editing/deleting comments, mentions, attachments on comments, real-time push.

## Product rules (from story)

- Internal comments are **staff-only**. They must never be returned by any endpoint exposed to the customer portal, nor included in customer-facing DTOs from `TicketsController`.
- Adding a comment must **not** mutate `Ticket.Status`, `Ticket.AssignedUserId`, `Ticket.UpdatedAt` (leave the ticket record untouched — the collaboration table has its own timestamps), or emit any status/assignment history entries.
- Only users with `tickets.collaboration.view` can list; only users with `tickets.collaboration.create` can create. Both also require the pre-existing ticket-scope access check used by `TicketsService`.
- Every create writes an audit log entry through `IAuditLogService`.

```csharp
public interface ITicketCollaborationCommentsService
{
    Task<IReadOnlyList<TicketCollaborationCommentDto>> ListAsync(Guid ticketId, ClaimsPrincipal user, CancellationToken ct);
    Task<TicketCollaborationCommentDto> CreateAsync(Guid ticketId, CreateTicketCollaborationCommentRequest request, ClaimsPrincipal user, CancellationToken ct);

```

**Create file:** `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Api/Tickets/Collaboration/TicketCollaborationCommentsService.cs`

Implementation rules:

- Inject `CrmDbContext`, `IAuditLogService`, and any ticket-scope access helper used by `TicketsService`/`CustomerNotesService`. Reuse the same helper — do not invent a new access check.
- Validate the ticket exists; return `NotFound`-style behaviour matching sibling services if not.
- `ListAsync`: order by `CreatedAt ASC`, project to DTO with author display name (join `Users`).
- `CreateAsync`:
  - Trim `Body`; reject empty/whitespace with a `ValidationException` (or the sibling services' equivalent) — mirror `CustomerNotesService`.
  - Reject `Body.Length > 4000`.
  - Set `Id = Guid.NewGuid()`, `AuthorUserId = user.GetUserId()`, `CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow`.
  - Save, then call `IAuditLogService` with entity type `"TicketCollaborationComment"`, entity id = new comment id, action `"ticket.collaboration.comment.created"`, and metadata `{ ticketId, commentId }`.
  - **Do not** touch the parent `Ticket` row.
- Return the freshly-created DTO (re-fetch or hand-map including `AuthorDisplayName`).

```csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/tickets/{ticketId:guid}/collaboration-comments")]
[Authorize]
public class TicketCollaborationCommentsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ITicketCollaborationCommentsService _service;
    public TicketCollaborationCommentsController(ITicketCollaborationCommentsService service) => _service = service;

    [HttpGet]
    [HasPermission(Permissions.Tickets_Collaboration_View)]
    public Task<IReadOnlyList<TicketCollaborationCommentDto>> List(Guid ticketId, CancellationToken ct)
        => _service.ListAsync(ticketId, User, ct);

    [HttpPost]
    [HasPermission(Permissions.Tickets_Collaboration_Create)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TicketCollaborationCommentDto>> Create(
        Guid ticketId,
        [FromBody] CreateTicketCollaborationCommentRequest request,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var created = await _service.CreateAsync(ticketId, request, User, ct);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(List), new { ticketId }, created);
    }
}
```

Match attribute ordering used in `TicketHistoryController.cs` / `CustomerNotesController.cs`.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Empty / whitespace-only body** — service throws validation; controller returns 400. Enforced in `TicketCollaborationCommentsService.CreateAsync` (see task 6). Frontend disables Submit when trimmed body is empty (task 11).
- **Body > 4000 chars** — EF `HasMaxLength(4000)` + service length check. Return 400 with a clear message.
- **Ticket not found** — service throws `KeyNotFoundException` (or the project's equivalent); controller returns 404. Mirror the sibling `TicketHistoryService` behaviour.
- **Ticket access denied for the caller** — reuse the ticket-scope access helper used by `TicketsService`; return 403.
- **Missing permission** — `HasPermissionAttribute` on the controller returns 403 before hitting the service.
- **Deleted user as author** — `AuthorUserId` FK uses `Restrict`; a comment can never orphan. Deleting a user with comments is not in scope (existing users flow already blocks/prompts on foreign keys).
- **Deleted ticket** — cascade delete removes comments; audit rows persist (per existing audit conventions).
- **Concurrent double-submit** from the compose form — client disables the Submit button while awaiting the POST; server treats each request independently (no dedup required at this stage).
- **Unicode / RTL text (Arabic, emoji)** — persisted as `nvarchar`; frontend uses `whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap'` and inherits the app's font stack.
- **Customer surface** — no customer-facing endpoint returns collaboration comments. Verified by grep-review during task 9. Executor **must** re-verify.

## Migration / Rollback

- **Apply:** the `AddTicketCollaborationComments` EF migration creates one new table with FKs; it does not modify any existing table.
- **Rollback:** `dotnet ef migrations remove` (before deploy) or `dotnet ef database update <PreviousMigrationName>` (post-deploy) drops the table. Because the feature is additive and no existing rows depend on it, rollback is safe.
- **Half-applied state:** if code is deployed without the migration, `List`/`Create` will fail at query time. Deploy migration first, code second.
